column1: # zerone-1 observer binary ladder (genesis sha256 c30a523b9764fb76c84a53d99fcdabb966d16e7a4d3f15426ab7af5e8576170e).
# One row per binary that executed zerone-1 blocks, in order. A row runs from `first` to `last`
# inclusive, then ends one of three ways:
#   upgrade:<name>  the binary stops by itself at the x/upgrade plan <name>, height last+1, and
#                   writes data/upgrade-info.json; the next row executes the plan block.
#   halt            the binary is started with --halt-height last+1, so its app refuses block
#                   last+1 (SDK 0.50.15 checkHalt: height >= halt-height) and the next row
#                   executes it.
#   tip             the last row; it follows the live chain.
# Heights come from GET reads of zerone-1 on 2026-11-06: the five applied plans
# (/cosmos/upgrade/v1beta1/applied_plan) and, for the non-upgrade image changes, the restart gap
# in block times after each Fly release (evidence/release-heights.jsonl). A non-upgrade boundary
# is exact to within one block: see RUNBOOK.md, "Boundary ambiguity".
# sha256 is the exact zeroned that ran, extracted from that release's binary layer only
# (tools/extract-rung-binary.sh). UNSET rows make build-image.sh refuse. The last row is the
# lane binary: 2e37c4c plus deploy/legacy-observer/observer-dependencies.patch (CometBFT 0.38.25,
# Go 1.25.14). d6391ea7... is that recipe's signed 2026-09-09 build; replace it with the lane
# binary's sha256 if the rebuild differs.
